page_title: EMP 0-5 ATA | Empoli v Atalanta 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
90' Great teamplay by Empoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
89' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 4:16.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Davide Zappacosta leaves the pitch and Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) comes on.
83' Liam Henderson (Empoli) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
83' The game is interrupted now, Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
83' Here is a change. Youssef Maleh is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli).
82' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
81' The percentage of ball possession is – 46:54.
76' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Mario Pasalic will be replaced by Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ademola Lookman as he is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta).

75' Ambitious effort from Thomas Campaniello (Empoli). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
74' 0 - 5 Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
73' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
72' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Sebastiano Esposito and he is replaced by Thomas Campaniello (Empoli).
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) for Alberto Grassi.
69' Atalanta are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
67' Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) is booked for saying more than Maurizio Mariani was willing to tolerate.
66' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
64' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) makes a strong challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. Empoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
63' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) replaces Berat Djimsiti.
63' It will be a substitution. Ederson (Atalanta) is ready to enter the pitch as Charles De Ketelaere walks off.
61' Empoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' PENALTY APPEAL after Junior Sambia (Empoli) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
59' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
59' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
58' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) replacing Christian Kouame.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Emmanuel Gyasi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Junior Sambia (Empoli).

55' 0 - 4 An amazing individual effort from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 0:4. Marco Silvestri was helpless.
50' The total number of attempts is 5:11.
47' Liam Henderson (Empoli) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' What a chance that is! Liberato Cacace (Empoli) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
45' It will be a corner kick for Empoli.
43' 0 - 3 Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is released by Mateo Retegui, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
41' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Maurizio Mariani had a clear view and blows his whistle. Empoli will take a free kick.
38' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Empoli.
38' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
36' Referee Maurizio Mariani points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) goes wild in celebration.
35' The Atalanta players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
33' 0 - 2 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Berat Djimsiti knock down. 0:2.
33' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

33' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Stefan Posch (Atalanta) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the left side of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Marco Silvestri makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
33' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
32' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
31' Stefan Posch (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli will take a free kick near the side line.

30' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
29' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. Empoli are awarded the free kick.
27' 0 - 1 OWN GOAL! Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 0:1.
27' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and it's Christian Kouame (Empoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Atalanta get a free kick.
25' The ball possession at the moment is 36:64.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Empoli.
20' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
18' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
16' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.

15' A pass travels right across the box to Christian Kouame (Empoli) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper into the roof of the net, but Marco Carnesecchi denies him with a decent save.
14' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle as Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Free kick. Empoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
11' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
9' Atalanta control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Liam Henderson (Empoli) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
7' Marco Silvestri (Empoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
5' Atalanta win a corner.

4' A sweet pass finds Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Marco Silvestri is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
2' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will referee today's match.
